=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:854-894 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: reset_ops (lines 873-878 GUARD_STOPS branch, reached from retry_budget at 1116-1118, accept_with_followup at 1292, regrant_ops at 1339, hold-followup at 1434-1436) does not handle a routed planning scope block (`ai:blocked` + `ai:scope-blocked`); with has_plan=True it calls `_approve` and posts `/approved` on the stale plan, and in both branches it removes only `ai:scope-blocked` and leaves `ai:blocked` on the issue.
  WHY: Only override_guard is filtered for this stop in unblock_ledger.decide, and only the override_guard branch (lines 1157-1178) has the fix, so a retry_budget/accept_with_followup/regrant verdict can start implementation from the stale plan, and the leftover `ai:blocked` makes stop_for_labels resolve to stop `blocked`, so the issue is resumed a second time while the first resume is still running; all four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:99-143 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `open_fence` is set to True when a line matches OPEN_FENCE_RE and is never reset, so a later valid `SCOPE_MISSING:` line is rejected with `reason=unclosed_fence`.
  WHY: The reviewers give different triggers: gemini says any closed fence (conf 5, no severity); minimax says a closed fence whose body has a ```-prefixed line, which non-greedy FENCE_RE strips only partway (NIT, conf 3); glm says a line starting with an inline code span (NIT, conf 2). The fallback fails safe to the unrouted path. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected gemini's form because FENCE_RE.sub strips every complete fenced block before the loop runs.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2658-2665 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "Handle blocked planning output" step calls `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` on every routed planning block, and that helper runs `gh_retry gh label create` when the label is not cached, adding a GitHub API call.
  WHY: This conflicts with the requirement "No new GitHub API calls; create `ai:scope-blocked` only when absent". gemini stated no severity, so medium is a placeholder. The same issue appears as a task gap below (luna MAJOR, minimax NIT); glm and sonnet dispute it.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:213 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `jq -c '.[:100]'` truncation used to build paths_b64 is dead/misleading, because `count=` comes from the untruncated paths_json.
  WHY: The 20-path guard runs first, so no live discrepancy can be reached; the slice is not a working cap (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_actions.py reset_ops branch for `stop == "scope-blocked"` (lines 873-878), and the resume routes in plan() (around lines 1116-1118, 1292; also regrant_ops at line 1339)
  confidence=5

The override_guard branch (lines 1157-1178) handles this case and reset_ops does not, and no test in `tests/test_unblock_judge.py` covers a non-override_guard verdict on a routed planning scope block. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says the same hole is covered by its CORRECTNESS finding and needs no separate gap.
- requirement: "§15: no new GitHub API calls. ... The label is created with the existing `ensure_label_exists` helper only when it is absent; that helper's read already runs for `ai:blocked`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml "Handle blocked planning output" step (line 2659 `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"`) and scripts/label_helpers.sh:ensure_label_exists() (lines 202-206)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/label_helpers.sh:193` keys its cache per label (`${repo}|${label_name}`), so the `ai:blocked` call does not prevent a create; `scripts/label_helpers.sh:202-206` runs `gh_retry gh label create` for any uncached label and handles "already exists" only after the request is made; plan.yml:2659 calls the helper without checking whether the label exists. changelog.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md and the agents fragment document the extra `gh label create` as a deliberate deviation. Disputed: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it (conf 3) because Approach step 6 specifies the call; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to re-flag it because the previous editor kept the call on purpose (`gh issue edit` fails on a missing label).

  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, alongside create_judge_fixup_issues_from_verdict
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The helper exists (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10780-10906`) but is about 126 lines and embeds a multi-line Python script through `printf '%s' "${aftc_body}" | python3 -I -B -c '...'`, not a "small pure helper" or a standalone `.py` entry point beside `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`. Severity: minimax NIT. Disputed: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it (conf 2) because the helper exists, is wired at both judge-issue sites and is tested, so this is not a completeness defect.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:873-878 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: reset_ops has no handling for the routed planning block state (`ai:blocked` + `ai:scope-blocked`). For stop `scope-blocked` it removes only `ai:scope-blocked`, and when an older plan exists it calls `_approve`, which posts `/approved` on the plan the failed planning run was meant to replace. Callers: retry_budget (line 1118), accept_with_followup (line 1292), regrant_ops (line 1339), hold-followup / fix-up commands (lines 1434-1436).
  WHY: unblock_ledger.decide (lines 986-996) filters only override_guard for this stop. If the judge picks retry_budget: (a) with has_plan=True, `/approved` starts implementation from the stale plan; (b) with has_plan=False, `/reclarify` leaves `ai:blocked`, so stop_for_labels resolves the issue to stop `blocked` and resumes it a second time. Minimal fix: a `planning_scope` check that skips `_approve` and removes `ai:blocked`.
- Rejected pass-1 claim: `open_fence` in scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh never resetting is not a bug, because FENCE_RE.sub strips every complete fenced block first. The cases it does not strip (an empty fenced block, a 4-backtick fence) only cause `reason=unclosed_fence`, which fails closed.
- Task completeness: NONE new. The extra `gh label create` from `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` is not re-flagged (scripts/label_helpers.sh lines 193-206 create without reading first, kept deliberately and documented). The heal-report run is deferred because its fix is outside files_touched. `add_files_touched_companions` exists at both judge sites. The sweep-only poller steps need no JUDGE_FILES_TOUCHED_COMPANIONS_ENABLED.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml "Route planning scope block" step, `bash "${route_script}" || echo "scope_routed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"`. A router failure logs no PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK line, so `helper_failed` never shows up. Fix: also echo `PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK outcome=not_routed issue=${ISSUE_NUMBER:--} paths=0 reason=helper_failed` (2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_actions.py reset_ops lines 873-878. Add the `planning_scope` check (5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:135-143 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The unclosed-fence detection wrongly flags valid scope lines that appear after a closed code fence.
  WHY: `open_fence` is set to True at an opening fence and never reset at a closing fence, so any `SCOPE_MISSING:` line after the first fence is rejected with `reason=unclosed_fence`.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2658-2665 (Handle blocked planning output step) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pipeline makes an unnecessary GitHub API call on every routed planning block.
  WHY: `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` runs `gh_retry gh label create` when the label is not cached, which violates "No new GitHub API calls; create `ai:scope-blocked` only when absent."
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Add a small pure helper, `add_files_touched_companions <body>`, in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`." | Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | Evidence of absence: The helper is a large Bash function that embeds a 60-line Python script through `printf | python3 -I -B -c`, which is not a "small pure helper" and goes against the guidelines on complex inline scripts. | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

  WHY: Later valid `SCOPE_MISSING:` lines silently fail to route, and the override_guard offer is skipped. The tests cover only the single-fence case.
